# ==========================================

# 1. Configuration & Secrets (Important!)

# ==========================================

# Ignore the configuration file automatically generated by the 'ask' command

# It contains, among other things, the Gemini API key (ApiKey / URL)

.config.json

# ==========================================

# 2. Cryptographic Tools (cmd/crypto)

# ==========================================

# The 'encrypt' and 'decrypt' commands generate folders with keys and encrypted files by default

encrypted/
decrypted/
keys/

# AES keys saved as text files and temporary zip files

key.txt
_.tmpzip
_.zip.enc
\*.enc

# ==========================================

# 3. Developer & System Tools

# ==========================================

# The 'files-combine' command combines files into 'combined.txt' by default (or the name specified with the -n flag)

combined.txt

# Any other text files generated as a result of the combination:

combined\_\*.txt

# The 'checksum' command allows automatically saving checksums to files (.sha256, .sha512, .md5)

_.sha256
_.sha512
\*.md5

# Temporary files generated during atomic writes (AtomicWrite in the annotate module)

_.tmp._

# Ignore files for the 'annotate-regions' command

.cmdr_reg_ignore

# The ignore file generated by 'tree' using the --generate-ignore flag

.cmdrignore

# ==========================================

# 4. Standard Go & Environment Files

# ==========================================

# Local executables and environment files

/bin/
cmdr
cmdr.exe
_.env
_.env.\*
